target_customer: Women who shop online for fashion and enjoy game style discovery
problem: Finding new fashion items is tedious; HauteDay organized daily themed fashion discoveries into shoppable collections with game mechanics.
business_model: Not stated in sources read; likely affiliate or retail commissions (unconfirmed)
product_category: Social fashion discovery and shopping community with game mechanics

founders.name: Michael Witz
previous_startups: Redemption Games (founder and CEO, per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Angel investor in over 300 companies and funds per YC page.

founders.name: Dan Lin
founders.background_notes: No bio on the YC page.

competitors.name: Polyvore
competitors.what: Social shopping site where members build sets and collections that link to retailers
competitors.traction_then: Reported average order value of 383 dollars versus 200 for Pinterest; launched in 2007

technical_complexity.rationale: A consumer web and mobile community with curation and game mechanics; no hard technical problem is described.

defensibility.rationale: Polyvore, Wanelo, Lyst and Fancy already did social fashion discovery and nothing in the sources shows a data or network advantage.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Polyvore was bought by Yahoo in 2015 per a parsers.vc summary; no source describes any reaction to HauteDay.

market_need_then: Social shopping was growing; a 2014 article reports social commerce converting well on Polyvore, but no HauteDay specific demand evidence was found.

branding.domain_note: Used hauteday.com (exact name .com); it returned a 503 error in 2026.

identity.voice_and_tone: Tagline: Gaming Meets Women's Shopping; also described as a community that finds the best new items in fashion.

brand_strength.rationale: Search found no press on the brand; 'haute' invites spelling variation and the name mixes fashion with a gaming pitch.

outcome_analysis: HauteDay was a two founder YC S14 company combining game mechanics with fashion shopping that received the standard 120K YC deal in August 2014. No launch coverage, traction, shutdown date or cause was found; the directory marks it Inactive, so the cause of failure is not public.
notes: hauteday.com returned HTTP 503 so the site status is unknown. The only funding items are the Xconomy 120K accelerator notice dated 2014-08-19 (recorded as other, the YC deal) and a CB Insights entry showing 20K from Y Combinator that may be a different or conflicting figure; both rest on one source each. No press about launch or Demo Day was found. Polyvore evidence is one 2014-01 article; Wanelo, Lyst and Fancy were seen only in undated or later results and were not listed. Founded year unknown.
